binding._doc: Declarative backend role binding for OT GPIO — the SECOND-device generalization gate (Step 6). GPIO has interrupts but NO chardev/FIFO data path, so this binding has only an `irq` block (no `chardev`). Hand-authored from bindings/gpio.digest.json + bindings/SCHEMA.md; validated by --backend-binding; drives the SAME qemu.irq_blueprint as BackendCharDevDetect, so gpio_qp_shim.c is byte-identical to the auto-detected golden.
